description: Automerge non-major language server updates after they are 3 days old. Only extend this in packages whose CI runs the smoke test. Also enables semantic commit messages, from which the release workflow decides whether to release.

packageRules.description: Server updates bundled through npm or uv
Server updates tracked by a custom manager, such as a version in plugin.py
